Website pehle aur baad mein

"Pehle" asli website ke screenshots hain. "Baad mein" naya proposed design hai. Isay dekh kar neeche approve karein, us ke baad hi website ka code change hoga.

    Font chunein

    Inter aur Montserrat ki jagah teen professional options. Teeno commercial use ke liye free hain. Card par click karein to upar ka design usi font mein dikhega.

    Naya color system

    Logo ke purple, magenta aur orange wahi rahenge. Fark yeh hai ke har color ka kaam fix hoga aur text har jagah saaf parha jayega.

        Audit mein kya mila

        Yeh nataij 18 pages ko browser mein 8 screen sizes par test kar ke mile hain.

        MaslaKahanPriorityHal
        Headline likhti aur mit-ti rehti haiHome. 10% waqt khali, 37% adhooriHighFixed headline
        Orange aur magenta text kam contrastPoori siteHighNaye color tokens
        Contact form bahut neecheContact, mobileHighForm pehli screen par

        Jo pehle se theek hai

        • 320px se 1920px tak kisi page par horizontal scroll nahi.
        • Har page par sirf ek H1 hai.
        • Tamam images mein alt attribute maujood hai.
        • Reduced motion setting par content chhupta nahi.
        • Site ki tamam photos pehle se WebP hain.

        Aap se yeh content chahiye

        • 3 asli client reviews. Abhi placeholder hain.
        • Stats ki tasdeeq: 100+ projects, 50+ clients, 5+ saal.
        • Pricing ki purani qeemat ($349, $649, $1,199) ki tasdeeq.
        • Pakistan aur UK office ka poora address.
        • Company ki asli kahani About page ke liye.

        Approve karein

        Jo cheez nahi chahiye us ka tick hata dein. Phir message copy kar ke chat mein bhej dein.

        Design decisions

        Aap ka approval message

        Yeh design preview hai, asli website abhi change nahi hui. Yahan 8 main page types dikhaye gaye hain. Team, Portfolio, Courses, Jobs, Book a Demo, location aur 404 pages approval ke baad isi system mein banenge.
